description: Identifier-domain drift. Three incompatible key forms flow through one HashMap<String,...> namespace: translation keys (block.minecraft.stone) from Cache.generate, tag ids (minecraft:mineable/axe) from streamTags, and pack-authored names. MaterialRegistry.material() looks up with Block.getName(), which returns a Text, not a String -- so it type-checks via getOrDefault(Object,V) and misses on every call.
naive_change: key materials and tags by String in one shared map

description: Shared-mutable-map pipeline. Utils.memoize mutates its input map (remove=true) while the resolver lambda still reads that same map, and the lambda closes over the loop variable name instead of the memoized key -- so recursive tag resolution attributes blocks to the wrong tag and silently drops each tag's explicit blocks list.
naive_change: memoize over a mutable HashMap with a closure-captured loop variable

description: Minecraft coupling blocks verification. The entire pipeline imports Registries, BlockState, ResourcePack, FabricLoader, and Gson's internal LinkedTreeMap, so no part of it can execute without a full Loom/Minecraft toolchain. Nothing has ever been tested; there is no src/test and no test dependency in build.gradle.
naive_change: put pure data transformation in classes that import Minecraft

description: Absent input data. resounding.tags.json and resounding.materials.json are read from resource packs but have never existed anywhere in the repo's history (verified across all branches). Everything is therefore dropped by refineMaterials for want of physical properties.
naive_change: defer all material data to user resource packs with no shipped defaults

description: Silent numeric degradation. Property.count is an int but Property.add takes a double count; the compound assignment this.count += count truncates, destroying fractional compositions. flattenMaterials indexes composition[i] against solute.length without a length check, and shellMaterials writes composition[0] unguarded.
naive_change: accumulate weighted averages in an int counter and trust pack array lengths

description: Null as the universal error channel. memoize collapses cyclic, absent, and legitimately null into a single null plus an ERROR log, and leaves its in-progress null marker in the output map. Callers cannot distinguish or recover.
naive_change: signal all resolution failures by returning null
